item.title: CHADD Response Regarding the November 2025 Article in The Wall Street Journal - CHADD
item.description: This blog breaks down why recent claims about ADHD medications are misleading, explaining how a narrow, high-risk Medicaid subgroup was misinterpreted and why polypharmacy reflects systemic gaps—not ADHD treatment itself. CHADD experts emphasize evidence-based care, clearer information for families, and the need to strengthen behavioral health systems rather than fueling fear.
